elon didn't name anyone else, but the numbers line up with what he said about micron being "reasonable" and others "extortionate".  over the three quarters to june, samsung's own realized DRAM price rose ~4x. sk hynix's rose 2.5-3x.  micron set its long term deals up differently:
$AMAT  is targeting share gains and higher non-GAAP margins by 2030, with advanced logic, DRAM, packaging and services driving the plan.
